last.verdict: CoreWeave beat on profit and demand, raising 2026 revenue guidance, but its debt-funded build-out keeps losses large with profit not expected until 2028.

takeaways.label: Profit and backlog beat
takeaways.text: Adjusted operating income hit $379M against a $200–260M target, and contracted backlog reached about $132.5B, up from roughly $104B last quarter.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised
takeaways.text: 2026 revenue guidance rose to $13.0–13.3B, with annualized revenue expected to reach $20–21B by year-end. Management says it is largely sold out through 2027.

takeaways.label: Heavy debt still drives losses
takeaways.text: Net loss was $709M on $846M of interest expense, and Q4 interest is guided to $1.05–1.15B. Management expects adjusted net income only in 2028.

takeaways.label: Customers now fund the build
takeaways.text: About $9B of customer prepayments is expected within three months, and most remaining spending will use contract-backed loans. Older GPU capacity is re-renting at 30–50% higher prices.

history.verdict: Profit beat and a higher revenue outlook outweighed bigger spending plans and widening losses.

reasons.label: Profit far above plan
reasons.text: Adjusted operating income hit $128M, more than double the company's own ~$60M target.

reasons.label: Higher revenue outlook
reasons.text: 2026 revenue guidance rose to $12.4–13.2B; Q3 guide of $3.45–3.6B beat $3.43B consensus.

reasons.label: Backlog keeps ballooning
reasons.text: Contracted backlog reached about $104B, up 246% from a year earlier.
